## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
Recent weather developments indicate ongoing and anticipated cyclonic activity affecting the Chennai–Puducherry coast. Cyclone Arnab, which made landfall on October 28, 2026, near Yanam, a region within Puducherry, prompted precautionary measures that successfully averted significant losses. Yanam is geographically situated within Andhra Pradesh but is administratively part of the Union Territory of Puducherry, making it relevant to the broader Chennai-Puducherry coastal region.

Looking ahead, Chennai is under a heavy rain alert for November first and second. This is due to a new low-pressure system that has formed over the Bay of Bengal and is expected to intensify and move towards northern Tamil Nadu and southern Andhra Pradesh coastal regions around November 1. While the exact intensity and path of this developing system are still being monitored by weather experts, it has the potential to bring widespread rainfall to Chennai and surrounding districts, signaling an intensification of the Northeast Monsoon. Residents in these areas are advised to stay informed through official weather updates and take necessary precautions.
